title: RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:2610.16443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. translated_title: RAP-WAM：通过预测性演练与动作扰动学习世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 近期的世界动作模型借助视频生成先验来联合预测未来观测和机器人动作。要将这些先验适配到控制任务中，需要确定未来预测应如何指导策略学习。RAP-WAM 将预测性演练与动作扰动（RAP）与未来监督查询及耦合动作投影相结合用于策略学习。预测性演练在模型生成的输入上进行训练，同时保留真实记录的目标，并将反复出现的错误积累为空间先验。我们对动作施加扰动并测量视频预测的变化，基于动作-响应的时空信用分配机制将这些响应、预测误差和演练先验结合起来以分配视觉监督；对响应进行空间聚合可确定跨未来动作步骤的监督强度。该方法无需额外的评分网络或部署时的探针。其基础模型从视频预训练的主干网络中学习……
tldr: 提出 RAP-WAM 框架，通过预测性演练和动作扰动将视频生成先验转化为策略学习的视觉监督信号，无需额外评分网络或部署时探针即可实现世界-动作模型的机器人控制学习。
en_tdlr: RAP-WAM learns world-action models by converting video generation priors into policy-learning visual supervision through predictive rehearsal and action perturbations, requiring no separate scoring network or deployment-time probe.
